name: acceptance-v1
definedBefore: any backtest, forward test or data download for this strategy. These criteria are fixed for strategy version 1.x; changing them requires a new criteria version, logged with its reason, and does not apply to results already seen.
costScenario: base costs from the strategy config unless a criterion says otherwise

outcomes.inconclusive: no criterion failed but at least one could not be evaluated (for example too few trades)
outcomes.eligible_for_review: every criterion passed. This only means the owner may review the evidence; it is never permission to trade real money and never moves anything to live trading by itself.

backtest.name: Enough trades
backtest.rule: holdout has at least 100 closed trades and validation has at least 60

backtest.name: Positive expectancy after costs
backtest.rule: mean R per trade > +0.10 in validation AND in holdout

backtest.name: Expectancy not explained by noise
backtest.rule: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap confidence interval of mean R in the holdout > 0 (10,000 resamples, fixed seed)

backtest.name: Profit factor
backtest.rule: holdout profit factor >= 1.20 at base costs and >= 1.00 at twice the base costs and slippage

backtest.name: Drawdown
backtest.rule: holdout maximum drawdown of simulated equity <= 10%

backtest.name: Not a few exceptional trades
backtest.rule: holdout mean R stays >= 0 after removing the best 5% of trades, and no single symbol contributes more than 40% of net profit

backtest.name: Not one correlated cluster
backtest.rule: holdout mean R excluding the ai_tech cluster is >= 0

backtest.name: Stable nearby settings
backtest.rule: in validation, mean R > 0 for at least 70% of the one-at-a-time neighbouring settings listed in stressTests.neighbours

backtest.name: Ambiguous bars do not decide the result
backtest.rule: holdout mean R > 0 with the conservative stop-first assumption (target-first is reported as sensitivity only)

forward.name: Review milestone
forward.rule: at least 100 closed forward-test trades AND at least 3 calendar months since forward testing started, whichever is later

forward.name: Rules frozen
forward.rule: every forward trade used the same strategy version and config hash; no rule change after the forward test started

forward.name: Consistent with the backtest
forward.rule: forward mean R > 0 and inside the holdout 95% bootstrap interval

forward.name: Operationally clean
forward.rule: signals rejected for stale data or processing errors <= 5% of forward signals, and no duplicate trades

informational: Comparison with equal-weight buy-and-hold of the universe and with SPY over the same dates (return, maximum drawdown, return per unit of drawdown). Reported, not a pass/fail gate, because the strategy is mostly in cash.
Results by symbol, sector, regime (SPY trend and volatility), year and time of day.
Losses larger than the planned risk (gaps through the stop) and their frequency.
